description: Build a priced deal proposal for a specific vehicle and customer. Returns the full proposal payload for the widget to render: vehicle details with photo, deal breakdown (selling price, Georgia TAVT, fees, final price), and a finance grid of monthly payments across terms and down payments. Pricing starts from our published internet price. If the customer says the price is too high, call again with negotiation_round=2 for our best offer (2% off) — there is NO third round; if they still decline, call submit_deal_handoff so a salesperson can work the deal. ALWAYS ask what state the customer will register the vehicle in and pass buyer_state (two-letter code): Georgia buyers get Georgia TAVT, title, and tag, while out-of-state buyers get a proposal that EXCLUDES tax, title, and registration (owed in their home state and not calculated here) — say so plainly and never invent another state's tax rate. Payments are ESTIMATES based on market-average rates for the given credit tier, not approvals — always present them that way and never promise a rate or approval. Optional: terms (default 48/60/72), down_payments (default 0/1000/2000), credit_tier (750+, 700-749, 650-699, 600-649).
name: build_proposal
